titleTr: Başvuru e-postası: although, however ve hafta tekrarı

explainTr: 'Although' (ya da 'though') bir karşıtlık cümleciği başlatır: Although she was nervous, she did well. Bu yapıda ikinci cümleye 'but' eklenmez; bir cümlede ya Although ya da but olur, ikisi birden olmaz.

'However' ise yeni bir cümleyi bağlar ve genelde başa gelir; arkasından virgül konur: She was nervous. However, she did well. Noktalı virgülden sonra da kullanılır: She was nervous; however, she did well.

Bugün hafta tekrarı da var: Past Perfect (had + V3), future time clauses (when + Present Simple), might / must / can't ve should / had better. Resmi bir e-postada although ve however cümlelerini güzel birleştirir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'rağmen' ve 'ama' birlikte kullanılabilir: 'Yorgun olmama rağmen ama çalıştım' demezsin; ama 'Yorgundum ama çalıştım' dersin. İngilizcede Although I was tired, I worked. Burada 'but' kullanma. Cümle başında 'However' ise 'Ancak, ...' demektir.
table: Though he is tired, he works.
Although it rained, but we went ✗

reading.title: The follow-up email
reading.text:
After the interview, Hafsa waited for a week. Although she felt good about her answers, she was still nervous. Then she remembered Linda's advice: send a polite follow-up email. However, she was not sure how to write one.

That evening, Emre helped her with a first draft. "Start with the reason you are writing," he said. "Although the email is short, it should still sound professional." Hafsa typed carefully: "Dear Ms. Rivera, I am writing regarding my recent interview for the substitute teacher position. Thank you for the opportunity. Although I am new to American schools, I am enthusiastic and ready to learn. I have attached my updated resume and two letters of recommendation. Please let me know if you need more information. I am available at any time that is convenient for you. Sincerely, Hafsa."

Emre read it twice. "It's good, Mom. However, you should check the spelling of 'opportunity.'" She fixed it and pressed send.

Two days later, the reply came. Ms. Rivera wrote that the district would like to hire Hafsa as a substitute teacher. Although this was exactly the news she wanted, Hafsa could hardly believe it. She read the email three times and then called Linda. "I got the job!" she said. Linda laughed. "Of course you did. You prepared, you were polite, and you were honest. You never stopped trying."

That night, Hafsa wrote a new line at the top of her study list: "First day of work: next Monday." Her English was not perfect yet. However, for the first time, she felt that her goal was real.

writing.promptTr: Mülakattan sonra Ms. Rivera'ya resmi bir başvuru e-postası yaz. Although ve However kullan; neden yazdığını söyle, teşekkür et (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a formal application email to Ms. Rivera after your interview. Use although and however, and thank her.
frames: Dear Ms. Rivera, I am writing regarding ...
Thank you for the opportunity to ...
writing.model: Dear Ms. Rivera, I am writing regarding the substitute teacher position at Lincoln Elementary. Thank you for the opportunity to interview last week. Although I am new to American schools, I am enthusiastic and I learn quickly. However, I know that I still need to improve my English, so I study every day. I have attached my resume and two letters of recommendation. Please let me know if you need more information. I am available any day that is convenient for you. Sincerely, Hafsa
